content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02030 If the parameter ComTxIPduClearUpdateBit of an I-PDU is configured to Con- firmation , the AUTOSAR COM module shall clear all update-bits of all contained signals and signal groups after this I-PDU was sent out via PduR_ComTransmit , PduR_ComTransmit returned E_OK and the I-PDU was successfully confirmed.
